name: @otuekong-portfolio/infrastructure-server
description: Server-only edge platform infrastructure and adapter utilities for the portfolio ecosystem. Manages environmental configuration validation, Upstash Redis client instantiations, rate-limiting interceptors, Resend API mail distribution workflows, and server-side telemetry handlers, completely decoupled from browser runtimes.
author: Otuekong Bassey <otuekong.bassey@gmail.com>
